test: Composite interaction: cover-tier (CB1/CB2/CB3+/S-DB from nflverse depth charts, matched via PFF primary coverage matchup + nflId->gsis crosswalk) x Route-Depth Signature (measured tracking kinematics)

result.kinematic_means_by_tier: speed_max 6.79-6.85 m/s across all tiers; sep_min 1.68-1.77 m — NO meaningful separation

honesty.what_was_expected: better corners suppress deep routes or shift the kinematic signature (composition of Interior Vacuum-family primitives with Route-Depth Signature)
honesty.what_was_measured: deep-route choice and the kinematic signature are statistically indistinguishable across cover tiers (p=0.88); the signature's power (AUC 0.85-0.88) does NOT come from who covers the receiver
honesty.interpretation: this is a REAL FINDING, not a failure: the Route-Depth Signature is coverage-agnostic — the receiver's own kinematics encode the route independent of the defender's quality tier. It means the primitive composes with NOTHING on the cover-tier axis; composition claims for Interior Vacuum x Route-Depth are RETRACTED pending a different mechanism path
honesty.power_note: n=925 pooled; chi2 has ~85% power to detect a 12pp effect; effects smaller than that are not excluded by this test

failure_taxonomy: avoided #3 (correlation): refused to multiply tier x signature without an interaction test
avoided #12 (adversarial): the null result is published as the finding
